source.binary: libUnreal.so copied from the live TFT PBE process mapping

methodology.xref: AArch64 ADRP/ADD registration references in the exact shipped binary.
methodology.default_decode: File-backed referenced words use ELF PT_LOAD VMA mapping; constructor arguments and constructor control flow establish command-pipe defaults.
methodology.scope: Static capability/default audit only; no static value is TFT FPS evidence.

observations.help: Coalesce repeated material-parameter changes by deferring uniform-expression caching until draw time.
Permit asynchronous updates of material uniform-expression caches.

observations.evidence: mov w2,#2 at 0x5071d20 supplies the registration default.
observations.help: Value 2 enables all declared render-command pipes; value 1 limits piping to the render thread and value 0 uses individual tasks.

observations.evidence: Registration passes w2=0; the shared render-command-pipe constructor converts the non-disabled flag to documented default 1 before CVar registration.
observations.help: Enable the NiagaraDynamicData render-command pipe; on is the documented default.
Permit uniform-buffer uploads outside render passes in the Vulkan RHI.
observations.applicability: Backend-specific support evidence only; TFT's Unreal renderer uses the OpenGL RHI above ANGLE, so this is not an OpenGL tuning control.

runtime_cross_checks.evidence: The stage-1-8 transport simpleperf proxy attributed 31.49% of sampled TFT process cycles to RHIThread, independently confirming an active RHI thread in this workload.

qualified_unknowns.finding: The exact binary contains runtime lookups, but this audit did not recover a trustworthy registration default.
qualified_unknowns.decision: Do not infer a compiled default. A later isolated runtime transition proves effective value 1; the queued r.OpenGL.UBOPoolSize profile remains a distinct, isolated capacity hypothesis.

decisions.uniform_expression_enablement: reject_noop: deferred, asynchronous, and material uniform-expression cache paths are already compiled on
decisions.render_command_pipe_enablement: reject_noop: all declared pipes are selected and NiagaraDynamicData is already on
decisions.vulkan_uniform_upload: reject_irrelevant_to_active_rhi: it is already on and does not control the OpenGL RHI path used by TFT
decisions.rhi_command_list_candidate: retain_priority_2: Performance Max still explicitly bypasses command-list queuing; restoring r.RHICmdBypass=0 is separate from the already-enabled pipes and caches
decisions.boundary: The audit removes no-op hypotheses; it does not measure late-PvP frame pacing or prove a candidate FPS gain.
